data.name: Vision of Madness
data.description: You can give a creature a vision of madness as a melee touch attack. Choose one of the following; attack rolls, saving throws, or skill checks. The target receives a +%1 bonus to the chosen rolls and a -%1 penalty to the other two types of rolls. This effect fades after 3 rounds. You can use this ability %2 times per day.|max(DomainMadnessLVL/2,1)|VisionofMadnessTimes
